scope: Warm complete calls over resident typed U32 input. Every implementation captures input once: old Ink inside its runtime, trusted native JS and handwritten controls in the common driver, CPU/GPU in their transport. Wasm copies, result conversion, common checksum consumption and backend checks are timed. Direct compiled JS is separate from complete runtime calls. Original-source JS/Rust controls retain loops and materialised stages; matched controls use checked shortcuts. Normal JIT/release optimisation is enabled. Startup and shader preparation are separate. Wasm memory is exported linear-memory highwater, excluding JS/GPU/RSS.
